# Butler v0.0.21

## Change Log

- Made long-running Work execution more reliable with bounded, phase-aware
  context projection, schema-valid tool inputs, deterministic command
  completion, and durable operation-result replay.
- Strengthened Work integrity with explicit Turn relations, atomic disposition,
  watchdog recovery, and preservation of mixed App-owned state during the Agent
  storage split.
- Improved real project work through session-owned Git worktrees, safer native
  workspace file operations, verified multimodal attachments, and generated
  artifact delivery.
- Reduced runtime memory pressure, bounded Project Ledger publication memory,
  repaired expired session-view recovery, and added truthful provider quota and
  reconnect status.
- Added Z.AI GLM-5.3 Coding Plan support and consolidated the product around the
  App gateway by removing retired transports and benchmark-only scaffolding.
- Restored the certificate-free Windows community installer and repaired the
  macOS doctor check when retired hook integrations are absent.

## Distribution Contract

- macOS publishes an ad-hoc signed macOS App in unsigned DMG and ZIP assets.
  Apple Developer ID signing and notarization are not release prerequisites.
- Ubuntu x64 and ARM64 DEB packages, the Arch Linux x64 package, and the
  standalone Butler Agent archive are required release assets.
- Windows publishes an unsigned Windows community installer and SHA-256
  sidecar. Microsoft Store remains the future trusted-distribution path.
- A release is complete only after the tag workflows publish and verify the
  required platform assets and manifests. Manual out-of-band uploads do not
  substitute for a failed workflow.

This release supersedes v0.0.20 for desktop and Agent installations.
